profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a software developer with experience in Python/Django, TypeScript/React, and Docker. I've also worked with Deck.gl, Selenium, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, among other technologies.

I completed my Master's in Computer Science in May 2021 from the University of Missouri Kansas City. I also used to instruct Problem Solving & Programming Lab.

Recently, I have started contributing to open-source community especially TypeScript on Github
Github: https://github.com/zealpatel1990

projects.title: Data Extraction from Website
projects.description:
Built python program using selenium library for storing student's results in MySQL database.
In order to retrieve the result, wrote another python script using Beautiful Soup, pytesseract and pillow to solve captcha image with an accuracy of more than 90%.
Most difficult thing in project is to solve captcha code to get results, which I solved by downloading a bunch of captcha code and find common pattern in it then using Pillow, filled gaps in image then passed that image to tesseract engine which gives string output which is then entered in text box to successfully retrieve results.

projects.title: Checkers Board built with Django and Vue.JS
projects.description:
We built multiplayer Checker's Board with live game watching based on Django. We used Scrum methodology to built this game sprint after sprint (little by little). The best part of the game is its scalability and WebSockets. I tried with numbers of users who never saw our website or played American-checkers before and surprisingly navigation inside the Django application is intuitive. Also, we have numbers of features live game recording, autosave, resume game where you left of, see any network errors. Secure SQL database, live game sharing and watching with viewers counter, and much more in-game itself.

Also, we have an AI opponent so you can play alone as well.

Please contact me if you would like to see it in action.
